{{Infobox Location|name=Meed's Seeds|location=[[Badgetown]]|occupants=[[Meed]]|image=Meeds Seeds appearance.png}} '''Meed's Seeds''' is a seed shop, owned by [[Meed]]. It is located on the west side of the map, which is just right of the [[farm]] entrance! It is a green, semi tall building, which has a teal blue door and two rectangular windows. The Player can trade their [[crops]] and other [[Found Items|forageables]] in exchange for [[gummies]]. The first upgrade lets you water 20 spaces before needing a refill. ==='''Discounts'''=== [[File:Discount marker.png|thumb|Discount marker]]Every day, one product is selected for a 50% discount. The discount marker is a red sign with a smiling face. When previewing a discounted item, a red text saying "DISCOUNT" will appear.
